paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Probing accuracy with reduced training data.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between model size and accuracy for mBERT and XLM-R. The x-axis is labeled “Train size” and displays a linear scale ranging from 250 to 2000, with tick labels spaced at increments of 250. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and ranges from approximately 80 to 94, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of 2. The mBERT line, depicted in light blue and represented by a cross marker, begins at a value of approximately 88 at a train size of 250 and steadily increases to approximately 89.5 at a train size of 1500. The XLM-R line, colored in dark blue and marked with a cross, starts at a value of approximately 91.5 at a train size of 250, and progresses to approximately 92.8 at a train size of 1500.
